2608.10731.title: When Is a General Factor Distinguishable? Non-Proportionality, Stable Structure, and the Bifactor Decision
2608.10731.paper_summary: Whether an additional general dimension is necessary beyond correlated first-order factors is a property of the population covariance matrix, not of any estimator or design. This research establishes when that property can be decided. Where the general and group loadings are proportional within every cluster the bifactor structure is covariance-equivalent to correlated factors, so no sample size separates them (Proposition 1); where that proportionality fails in every cluster, three items per cluster and some mild regularities leave no $K$-factor model with diagonal uniquenesses able to reproduce the covariance matrix (Theorem 1); and between them lies a mixed boundary, located numerically here and turning on cluster resistance. Distinguishability is therefore graded, measured by the population distance to the $K$-factor class. Because that question is conditional on a first-order structure which is itself uncertain, a two-step procedure is developed within partially exploratory factor analysis, delivering a structure only when it reproduces across adjacent counts and treating non-delivery as legitimate. Simulation shows that a unanimous count can accompany a structure that fails to reproduce, and that absorbed local dependence can imitate a general factor, the error growing with sample size while stability indicators stay clean. Four empirical datasets illustrate the possible outcomes.
2608.10731.paper_summary_zh: 是否需要額外的一般維度超越相關的一階因素，這是人口協方差矩陣的特性，而不是任何估計量或設計的特性。這項研究確定了何時可以決定該特性。當每個群集內的一般和群組負荷成比例時，雙因子結構在協方差上等同於相關因素，因此沒有樣本大小將它們區分開來（命題 1）；當每個群集中的比例關係失效時，每個群集三個項目和一些輕微的規則使得沒有任何具有對角唯一性的 $K$-因子模型能夠重現協方差矩陣（定理 1）；而它們之間存在一個混合邊界，數值上位於這裡，並且依賴於群集的抵抗力。因此，可區分性是分級的，通過到 $K$-因子類的群體距離來衡量。因為該問題是基於一個本身不確定的一階結構，故在部分探索性因素分析中開發了一個兩步程序，僅在其在相鄰計數中重現時提供結構，並將未交付視為合理。模擬顯示，統一計數可以伴隨一個無法重現的結構，而吸收的局部依賴可以模仿一般因子，隨著樣本大小的增長，誤差也在增長，而穩定性指標保持乾淨。四個實證數據集說明了可能的結果。
2608.10731.author: Jinsong Chen et.al.
